summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all task requirements: unit tests for date math, config parsing, formatters, and CLI; integration tests for orchestration with injected I/O; end-to-end acceptance tests via act workflow execution; workflow structure validation. Edge cases (impossible dates, boundary urgency thresholds, empty arrays, field omissions) and error scenarios (invalid JSON, missing config, malformed dates, type violations) extensively tested with specific error message assertions. Well-organized by concern, clear fixtures (MIXED_FIXTURE, ALL_OK_FIXTURE), test independence via ephemeral repos and in-memory I/O mocks, and excellent readability with TDD-cycle comments. Act testing properly isolated and deterministically seeded (ROTATION_NOW=2026-06-28). Workflow structure tests validate YAML shape, permissions, job dependencies, action references, file existence, and actionlint compliance. Would reliably catch regressions.
